gen-gf-euphoria-script-gf-julius-sans-on: Relaxed is the first word for Euphoria Script, a loose pen-and-paper hand with tight-knit letters. Julius Sans One is its opposite in spacing, a sans with wide gaps and open curves, and that contrast is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa reads big and sturdy, a sans with tall-looking lowercase and curves that stay wide open and distinct. Euphoria Script is the one for graceful, handwritten flourish, while Lexend Exa does the steady work.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega looks drawn with a single nib, its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals. Beneath Euphoria Script's close-knit, casual handwriting, that sans-serif body gives the page a firm, modern footing without fighting the looseness above.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-gf-lexend-peta: Graceful comes through in Euphoria Script, a casual hand whose lowercase sits just a short step below its capitals. Lexend Peta, a sans-serif with no thinning in its curves, supplies the sturdy counterweight.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-gf-lexend-tera: Euphoria Script writes like a relaxed pen, its letters tucked close together and its capitals only slightly taller than the rest. And Lexend Tera, a sans-serif drawn with a plotter's single line, spaces its rounded letters wide like stepping stones.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-gf-lexend-zetta: Euphoria Script is handwriting at its most casual, a pen-and-paper hand with letters packed close together. Lexend Zetta, a sans with tall small letters and wide tracking, can take generous sizing, so let it grow a little.
gen-gf-euphoria-script-gf-montserrat-alt: Loose handwriting meets tidy geometry. Euphoria Script keeps its letters tucked close, while Montserrat Alternates, a plain sans with round, open shapes, would move steadily down a long page without tiring.
gen-gf-ewert-gf-graduate: Stretched, showy and a bit theatrical, Ewert has loose word shapes and hairline-thin openings. But Graduate, a classic serif with generous spacing and open letters, is the one that settles down to quiet reading.
gen-gf-fanwood-text-gf-cascadia-mono: Bookish headings meet code-editor body text. Fanwood Text carries a mild thick-thin shift and wide entrances, and Cascadia Mono, a plain sans with every stroke at the same pressure, would march down a long page like pins in a board.
gen-gf-fanwood-text-gf-julius-sans-one: Editorial in spirit, Fanwood Text has a comfortable thick-and-thin rhythm that is made for reading. Julius Sans One counters with marker-drawn plainness, a sans of wide spacing and open curves, and that clash is the pair's strongest quality.
